issue_title_zh: 通胀恶化拖累美股：标普创 7 月来最差单日，AI 股领跌
lead_zh: 今天读美联社（AP）周三收盘综述。9 月 CPI 升至 3.7%，超预期，美债收益率跳升，标普跌 1.1%、纳指跌 1.9%，Nvidia / Broadcom / AMD / CoreWeave 等 AI 相关股领跌。重点看：worst day since / rising yields / rein in / ride the AI frenzy / heaviest weights 这类财经套话。

article.title: US stocks drop to their worst day since July as inflation worsens
article.author: Stan Choe
article.published: 2026-10-14 16:03 EDT（北京时间 10 月 15 日 04:03；WRAL 页显示更新至 20:48 EDT）
article.excerpt_note: 节选自原文开篇、通胀与美联储段落，以及 AI 股拖累与收盘点位（约 400 词）。版权归 The Associated Press 所有，仅供个人学习，完整报道请看原文。
sections: U.S. stocks dropped to their worst day since July on Wednesday following the latest signal that inflation is getting worse.

The S&P 500 sank 1.1% for a fifth loss in the six days since setting its all-time high. The Dow Jones Industrial Average fell 48 points, or 0.1%, and the Nasdaq composite slid 1.9% as stocks in the artificial-intelligence industry led the way lower.

Stocks felt pressure from rising yields in the bond market, where worries grew after a report said U.S. consumers had to pay prices for fuel, food and other costs of living last month that were 3.7% higher overall than a year earlier. That means inflation accelerated from its 3.4% rate in August and was worse than the 3.6% that economists expected.

Inflation has remained more painful than anyone would like since the economy catapulted out of the crevasse created by the COVID-19 pandemic. It’s accelerated recently in part because of jumps in fuel prices caused by the war with Iran, and the price for a barrel of Brent crude added 0.4% Wednesday to $106.06.

The Fed recently raised the interest rate that it controls, which affects very short-term loans, for the first time in three years in hopes of reining in inflation. Higher rates do that by making it more expensive for everyone to borrow money and slowing the overall economy.
Traders now see a nearly 35% chance the Fed will raise the federal funds rate at its next meeting in two weeks, up from the 22% probability seen a day earlier, according to data from CME Group.
Much of Wall Street’s pain on Wednesday was due to drops for companies riding the AI frenzy to huge profit growth and stellar stock gains.

Higher bond yields making borrowing money more expensive could make it more difficult for companies to raise cash to build data centers and fill them with AI chips. Drops of 3.2% for Nvidia, 3.1% for Broadcom and 5.7% for Advanced Micro Devices were among the day’s heaviest weights on the S&P 500.

CoreWeave, which offers AI computing power to customers over the cloud, tumbled 15.5% for its worst day since February. GE Vernova, which is hoping to electrify power-hungry data centers, dropped 6.2%, and Oracle sank 8.8%.
All told, the S&P 500 fell 86.51 points to 7,718.94. The Dow Jones Industrial Average dipped 48.62 to 51,621.48, and the Nasdaq composite sank 511.51 to 26,692.87.

notes.head: drop to one’s worst day
notes.zh: 跌至……以来最差的一天。worst day since July = 7 月以来最差单日。新闻收盘常用。

notes.head: following + n.
notes.zh: 在……之后；随着……。following the latest signal = 在最新信号出现之后。比 after 更书面。

notes.head: get worse
notes.zh: 变得更糟。get + adj. 表变化：get worse / get better。标题也用 worsen。

notes.head: for a …th …
notes.zh: 这是第……次……。for a fifth loss = 这是第五次下跌。for a second straight day = 连续第二天。

notes.head: all-time high
notes.zh: 历史新高。set / hit an all-time high。对 all-time low。

notes.head: lead the way
notes.zh: 带头……。led the way lower = 领跌。也可 lead the way higher = 领涨。

notes.head: feel pressure from
notes.zh: 感受到来自……的压力。Stocks felt pressure from rising yields = 股指因债市收益率上行承压。

notes.head: yield
notes.zh: （债券）收益率。rising yields = 收益率上行，通常压制股价。10-year Treasury yield = 十年期美债收益率。

notes.head: cost of living
notes.zh: 生活成本。costs of living = 衣食住行等日常开销。CPI 衡量的就是这方面价格变化。

notes.head: accelerate
notes.zh: 加速。inflation accelerated = 通胀加快。反义 decelerate / ease。

notes.head: catapult
notes.zh: 弹射、猛然推出。catapulted out of the crevasse = 从深渊里猛冲出来。形象写疫情后经济反弹。

notes.head: crevasse
notes.zh: （冰川）裂缝、深渊。这里比喻疫情造成的经济深坑。比 hole / gap 更有冲击力。

notes.head: It’s = It has
notes.zh: 这里 It’s = It has（现在完成时），不是 It is。看后面 accelerated（过去分词）可判断。

notes.head: a jump in
notes.zh: ……的跳升。jumps in fuel prices = 燃料价格的几次急涨。财经常用 a jump / surge / spike in。

notes.head: rein in
notes.zh: 勒住、遏制。rein in inflation = 把通胀勒住。本义：收紧缰绳。

notes.head: make it + adj. + to do
notes.zh: 使做某事更……。making it more expensive … to borrow = 让借钱更贵。it 是形式宾语。

notes.head: federal funds rate
notes.zh: 联邦基金利率。美联储设定的隔夜拆借目标利率，加息/降息说的就是它。

notes.head: up from
notes.zh: 较……上升。up from 22% = 从 22% 升上来。对比：down from / versus。

notes.head: pain
notes.zh: 这里 pain = 下跌之痛、市场难受。Wall Street’s pain = 华尔街承压/受伤。注意 Street’s 用弯引号。

notes.head: ride the … frenzy
notes.zh: 搭上……狂热的顺风车。riding the AI frenzy = 借 AI 狂热行情。frenzy = 狂热。

notes.head: stellar
notes.zh: 杰出的、星级的。stellar gains / performance = 亮眼涨幅/表现。

notes.head: 现在分词作定语/原因
notes.zh: Higher bond yields making … expensive = 收益率上行「使得」借钱更贵。分词短语修饰前句，表因果。

notes.head: raise cash / capital
notes.zh: 筹资、融资。raise cash to build data centers = 筹钱建数据中心。

notes.head: a heavy weight on
notes.zh: 对指数拖累最大的成分。heaviest weights on the S&P 500 = 对标普拖累最重的几只股。

notes.head: tumble
notes.zh: 暴跌、急跌。tumble 15.5% = 暴跌 15.5%。比 fall / drop 更猛。

notes.head: power-hungry
notes.zh: 极度耗电的。power-hungry = 吃电的、耗电大户。hunger for power。

notes.head: sink
notes.zh: 下沉、大幅下跌。sank 8.8% = 跌了 8.8%。财经常用 sink / slide / slip。

notes.head: all told
notes.zh: 总的来说、合计。收盘综述常用 All told, the S&P 500 fell… = 全天合计……。

notes.head: dip
notes.zh: 小幅回落。dip 比 drop / tumble 轻：道指只 dip 了约 49 点（0.1%）。

review_words.example: Stocks felt pressure from rising yields in the bond market.
Inflation accelerated from its 3.4% rate in August.
The economy catapulted out of the pandemic crevasse.
Growth climbed out of the crevasse created by COVID-19.
The Fed raised rates in hopes of reining in inflation.
Traders raised odds the Fed will hike the federal funds rate.
Companies riding the AI frenzy saw huge stock gains.
They posted stellar stock gains this year.
CoreWeave tumbled 15.5% for its worst day since February.
GE Vernova wants to electrify power-hungry data centers.

patterns.pattern: A dropped to their worst day since B following C
patterns.zh: 在 C 之后，A 跌至自 B 以来最差的一天
patterns.from: U.S. stocks dropped to their worst day since July on Wednesday following the latest signal that inflation is getting worse.
patterns.model: Chip stocks dropped to their worst day since March following the weak guidance.
patterns.model_zh: 在疲软展望公布后，芯片股跌至自 3 月以来最差的一天。

patterns.pattern: A felt pressure from B, where C
patterns.zh: A 感受到来自 B 的压力，在那里 C
patterns.from: Stocks felt pressure from rising yields in the bond market, where worries grew after a report said…
patterns.model: Banks felt pressure from rising defaults, where worries grew after the jobs report.
patterns.model_zh: 银行感受到违约上升的压力，就业报告公布后担忧加剧。

patterns.pattern: A raised B in hopes of reining in C
patterns.zh: A 上调 B，以期遏制 C
patterns.from: The Fed recently raised the interest rate that it controls… in hopes of reining in inflation.
patterns.model: The company raised prices in hopes of reining in losses.
patterns.model_zh: 公司提价以期遏制亏损。

patterns.pattern: Drops of X for A … were among the day’s heaviest weights on B
patterns.zh: A 下跌 X……是当日对 B 拖累最重的之一
patterns.from: Drops of 3.2% for Nvidia, 3.1% for Broadcom and 5.7% for Advanced Micro Devices were among the day’s heaviest weights on the S&P 500.
patterns.model: Drops of 4% for Meta were among the day’s heaviest weights on the Nasdaq.
patterns.model_zh: Meta 下跌 4% 是当日对纳指拖累最重的之一。

podcast.title: St. Louis Fed President Alberto Musalem Talks Fed Rates
podcast.zh: 圣路易斯联储主席 Musalem 谈未来 6–9 个月或需加息、把通胀压回 2%。和今天 CPI 超预期、市场上调加息概率同一条主线，适合泛听抓 rate hike / inflation target。
